stages.name: Test
stages.notes: For Tests bought on or after 17 August 2026; earlier Tests need 5 trading days. No daily loss limit. The limit stops trailing at the starting balance. The best day must be strictly below 50%. TPT's Rule 5 page divides the best day by total net profit; its FAQ measures it against the profit target. Modelled against total profit. Breaking it delays passing; it does not fail the Test.

stages.name: PRO

payoutPaths.name: PRO daily withdrawal
payoutPaths.notes: Daily withdrawals from day one, but every withdrawal from an active PRO account must leave the balance above the buffer. Profits inside the buffer can only be taken by closing the account, which pays 50% (60 or fewer trading days) or 80% of them. No cap and no consistency rule.

stages.notes: The limit trails realised and unrealised peaks during the day until it reaches the starting balance. No daily loss limit.

stages.name: PRO+

payoutPaths.name: PRO+ daily withdrawal
payoutPaths.notes: Daily from day one, no buffer and no maximum.

stages.notes: PRO+ starts at a $0 balance; the limit trails realised end-of-day profit and stops at $0. Promotion is by review, and $5,000 of PRO profit is held on upgrade. TPT can move a trader to PRO+ Development with a smaller drawdown, a daily loss limit and fewer contracts, and pauses new purchases for 30 days after $10,000 of net live losses there; that stage is not modelled.
